authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 section 20.1 specifies padding bits until the next byte boundary after object handles and does not require their values to be zero; section 20.4.53 describes LAYER_CONTROL handle order.
finding: The reconciled AC1021 detached-control path rejected a bounded final alignment bit when it was one, imposing a zero-value requirement not stated by the object framing specification.
change: Allow either alignment-bit value after the parsed detached control handles while retaining the maximum seven-bit frame boundary and buffer-status checks. The separate producer-specific empty-string-footer validation is unchanged.
validation: The new nonzero-padding LAYER_CONTROL vector failed before the change, then passed. An additional whole trailing byte remains rejected with state reset and corrected same-object retry.
Both the AC1021 control CTest and the existing LibreCAD AC1021 fixture CTest pass in the normal build; the control CTest also passes with the library and test instrumented by AddressSanitizer.
limits: The nonzero alignment vector is locally generated, not a claim of native producer provenance or broad control support.
The LibreCAD fixture still has a strict-output integrity diagnostic. Selected inputs changed, reopening the candidate digest and platform qualification.
